name: SpaceX Falcon 9 Block 5 (reusable first stage, droneship recovery) — TIMELINE mode

stages.name: Stage 1 (9x Merlin 1D)

propellant_kg.derived: Block 5 LOX 287,400 kg + RP-1 123,500 kg tank capacities (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Falcon_9_Block_5#Specifications, citing Espace & Exploration No.39)

thrust_sl_N.src: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Falcon_9#Specifications (7,607 kN SL); SpaceX Falcon User's Guide https://www.spacex.com/media/falcon-users-guide-2021-09.pdf

cutoff_s.src: https://www.spacex.com/launches/sl-15-16 (SpaceX mission timeline, also content.spacex.com/api/spacex-website/missions/sl-15-16) MECO T+00:02:26

separation_s.src: https://www.spacex.com/launches/sl-15-16 (SpaceX mission timeline, also content.spacex.com/api/spacex-website/missions/sl-15-16) stage separation T+00:02:30

stages.note: TIMELINE: mdot = F_vac/(Isp_vac g0) = 2,689 kg/s at full published thrust; 146 s burns ~392.6 t of 410.9 t, the ~18 t residual stands in for entry/landing propellant (throttle profile unpublished)

propellant_kg.derived: Block 5 LOX 75,200 kg + RP-1 32,300 kg tank capacities (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Falcon_9_Block_5#Specifications)

diameter_m.src: fairing diameter 5.2 m (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Falcon_9#Payload_fairing); used as drag reference diameter for whole stack

ignition_s.src: https://www.spacex.com/launches/sl-15-16 (SpaceX mission timeline, also content.spacex.com/api/spacex-website/missions/sl-15-16) SES-1 T+00:02:36

cutoff_s.src: https://www.spacex.com/launches/sl-15-16 (SpaceX mission timeline, also content.spacex.com/api/spacex-website/missions/sl-15-16) SECO-1 T+00:08:39 (overridden per launch by final_cutoff_s)

jettison_time_s.src: https://www.spacex.com/launches/sl-15-16 (SpaceX mission timeline, also content.spacex.com/api/spacex-website/missions/sl-15-16) fairing separation T+00:02:56

header_notes: Falcon 9 Block 5 masses from Wikipedia 'Falcon 9 Block 5' spec table; thrust/Isp from Wikipedia 'Falcon 9' spec table (citing SpaceX).
TIMELINE mode (tuned 2026-10-25): MECO 146 s, stage sep 150 s, SES-1 156 s, fairing 176 s, SECO-1 (final cutoff) from SpaceX's sl-15-16 timeline are hard events.
Throttle profile not published: full published thrust throughout; unburned stage-1 residual stands in for entry/landing propellant.

cd.assumption: not published; generic slender-launcher Cd (same as Electron/previous F9 run). Not fitted: only first-stage family knots constrain drag, which would make Cd degenerate with the kick

payload_kg.basis: 27 V2 Mini Optimized: ~575 kg each community-reported (spacex.com.pl) = 15.5 t; MaxQ lists 800 kg each = 21.6 t (upper bound). Mass not published by SpaceX
